department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Complete applications by December 30 for full consideration for admission, support and college fellowships.
deadline.quote: must be received by December 30th of the preceding Fall term

gre_general.value: GRE General is required for all international applicants.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) aptitude scores are required for all international applicants.

funding.value: Admission is linked to available TA/RA/fellowship support; international students are usually supported by faculty RAs or a government fellowship.
funding.quote: Admission to the department is linked to the availability of support in the form of a graduate Teaching Assistantship (TA), research assistantship (RA), fellowship, or government scholarship.

entry_route.value: A four-year bachelor's in electrical engineering or a closely related field is the stated requirement.
entry_route.quote: Students should have a four-year bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field.
